section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1973
title: 19 ## INCIDENCE OF SUICIDE IN THE STATES, UNION TERRITORIES AND METROPOLITAN CITIES Out of 21 states, 9 states showed increases in the rate of suicide whereas 12 states recorded a decline. The overall result for states was a decline of 6·6 per cent in 1973 over 1972. The maximum increase in suicides was recorded in the state of Haryana and it went up by 63·4 per cent in 1973 over 1972. The state of Mghalaya recorded the maximum decrease (87·4 per cent) in 1973 over 1972.
